LEGAL DETAILS

المركز القانوني

Privacy Policy • سياسة الخصوصية

TECH OPTION processes limited Telegram account and service data only as reasonably necessary to operate subscriptions, support, security and troubleshooting. TECH OPTION does not sell users' personal information and does not request Telegram passwords.

Terms of Service • شروط الاستخدام

Access may depend on an active subscription or trial. Subscriptions are for the authorized user's own use. TECH OPTION may suspend access for abuse, fraud, security threats or unauthorized redistribution. Service features and availability may change.

Risk Disclaimer • إخلاء مسؤولية التداول

Market information, alerts and analysis are not personalized financial advice. Trading involves substantial risk, including possible loss of capital. No alert, strategy, target or historical result guarantees future performance. The user is responsible for all trading decisions.

Subscription & Refund • الاشتراك والاسترداد

Paid subscriptions are generally non-refundable after activation, except where a refund is required by applicable law. Unused time, missed alerts, personal trading results or a decision not to use the service do not automatically create a right to a refund.
